name: QIDI Q2 Safe Controls
description: Template for an iPhone Apple Shortcut using the authenticated Siri/Home Assistant bridge.
notes: Invoke this Shortcut only from explicit Siri/user intent. The bridge authenticates and binds every request to the paired printer. The printer displays a fresh short-lived challenge and confirmation for sensitive actions. Unauthorized or failed requests must be shown to the user and must not be retried as another operation. Shortcuts cannot provide a guaranteed endless background loop. Use the Home Assistant blueprint for continuous polling. This template contains no secrets and does not call a printer directly.
